gaps: Nabeel S. Qureshi portrait: none openly licensed. Commons 'Nabeel Qureshi' files show other people (a Pakistani film director/actor, and the late author and apologist, whose Flickr photo has the same name). His own site and social photos are copyrighted; ask him or skip. Do not mix up the namesakes.

Airbus A350 final assembly line: only one open-licensed interior (Bernd K, permission via a public tweet; JetPhotos source 403). Airbus's own media terms and images could not be read (airbus.com returned an Incapsula bot challenge, no Wayback copy), so no Airbus official image is offered. Commons FAL photos of the A330 and A380 exist but are the wrong aircraft. Qureshi's own essay image is a screenshot of a TV-documentary upload and is blocked.

Contextual inquiry / shadowing scenes: no Commons images found under that name. Closest are field interviews (DFAT Cambodia, Etnowiki Ukraine) and a desk usability test; none shows a researcher observing someone at a work site wearing a hard hat.

Ray Dalio from the World Economic Forum: none on Commons; the WEF Flickr photo (Davos 2014) is CC BY-NC-SA 2.0, so it needs a non-commercial check or WEF permission. All Dalio photos on Commons come from event or media Flickr accounts, not Dalio's own.

9/11 Commission hearing scenes: Commons has only two DoD photos (Rumsfeld; Myers/Wolfowitz/Rumsfeld, 2004-03-23). No testimony photos of Rice, Tenet or Clarke with a verifiable PD basis were found. The Commission's official 24-image June 2004 gallery has no photographer or rights statement and was not viewed. The commissioners' group photo is credited to an outside firm.

NARA and LOC were not searched directly: loc.gov and catalog.archives.gov timed out from this machine, the browser was denied loc.gov, and only a few loc.gov pages came through a fetch tool. The only NARA item (Ford, 1975) was found via Commons. FBI and CIA HQ images are dated 1980-2006 or 1975 and none is tied to 2001.

Book covers: only the Interviewing Users 2nd edition cover has an open licence (publisher's own Flickr, CC BY 2.0, publisher page not confirmed). Impro, The Looming Tower, Getting Things Done and Principles covers are all rights reserved. The edition Palantir actually sent is unknown for all four; Principles was an early PDF.

Visual verification was done for only two images (the A350 line photo and the Wurzburg Theatresports match). All others were judged from Commons descriptions. Several Commons 'own work' claims (Allen/TNW, Theatresports, hard hat, Etnowiki) have no external confirmation.
Commons file URLs were taken from the API; HEAD checks on upload.wikimedia.org hit HTTP 429 after about 25 requests and were abandoned, so those URLs were not individually confirmed.

Personality rights: nearly every portrait or event photo shows identifiable people with no model release evidence; keep use editorial. ShareAlike (CC BY-SA) files may bind the finished video; prefer CC BY, CC0 or PD files where equivalent.
